prompt: Briefly  explain what the popular open source tool crowdsec is
response: Crowdsec is an open-source security tool that focuses on protecting web applications from various security threats. It monitors and analyzes application logs to detect and block malicious activities in real-time. Crowdsec provides a user-friendly interface for managing security rules and integrates seamlessly with popular web servers and frameworks. It is designed to be highly efficient and easy to deploy, making it an excellent choice for securing web applications against modern threats.
